proposed_scenarios.description: This scenario documents a login failure. The agent attempted to explore the login workflow on Unsplash, but did not capture any actionable login interactions or reach the genuine authentication steps. The flow stopped on blank pages before any form submission or credential entry.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Capture and document the actual failed login exploration as observed.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As an automated test agent, I need to explore and document the login workflow, but in this run, the exploration did not reveal any valid steps or actions toward login.
expected_results: No login form or authentication workflow could be reached.
Agent remains on about:blank without accessing or interacting with Unsplash login page.
No authentication or user session is established.
The test captures an incomplete login state to aid debugging of agent/page failures.
edge_cases_to_test: Browser fails to load the expected initial URL (blank page).
Login UI not present or the system fails to navigate to login.
Agent unable to trigger any page interaction due to environment issues.
data_requirements: N/A (no credentials were entered or required).
prerequisites: Website must be accessible to the agent.
Agent environment must have browser/network connectivity.
